scientific_integrity: The enumeration and entropy theorem is reviewed within the authoring process; no external independent audit or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Proved for finite outward-oriented rooted trees, with asymptotic formulas only for fixed branching b>=2. The Wang congruence correspondence is established prior theory; no claim of independent proof of that classification or of comprehensive literature priority. Finite verification is non-exhaustive over all heights and graph families.
title: Congruence entropy and exponential Rees scarcity in rooted-tree graph inverse semigroups
